2. PD-8841 (missed carrier check-ins, Allentown): Moss's 4/27 digest. It may be the same ticket as #8841, but I can't confirm that.
3. #8841 again (Newark carrier portal, Dock Door 14): Moss's 9/30 digest. This conflicts with items 1 and 2, so the number may have been reused or the digest may be wrong.
4. PD-4418 (Carrier_Dwell_Summary export): Moss's 9/15/2025 digest. The digest says "the account Nadia runs," so I treated it as Group.
5. INC-4821 (Hartford gate kiosks, 2026-08-03): #inc-vtg-hartford.
6. VT-55120 (Hartford root-cause ticket): #inc-vtg-hartford, 2026-10-14.

I excluded #4812 (Mobility) and PD-4402 (Quillfeather). Nothing in the other digests I read listed a Group ticket number.

Before the steering committee, check the ticketing system for the full history. #8841 shows up with three different descriptions, and the 4/27 PD-8841 may be a separate ticket.
